business_summary: The Bank Of Kochi, Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Japan. It operates in three segments: Banking Business, Leasing Business, and Credit Card Business. The company offers deposit and comprehensive accounts; inheritance-only and retirement benefit-only fixed term, and foreign currency deposits; tax-free small investment system; accumulation investment and investment trusts; pension periodic payment; term-asset management; and government and private placement bonds. It also provides loan products, including car, housing, card, reverse mortgage, educational, and business loans, as well as loan consultation; insurance products, comprising medical and cancer, individual pension, property, whole life, and term insurance; guardianship system support deposit; trust contract agency business; individual-type defined contribution pension plan; testamentary trust and estate settlement services; dedicated account for educational donations; and inheritance procedures. In addition, the company offers services comprising internet banking, payment and transfer, electronic money and smartphone payment, payroll transfer, foreign exchange and remittance, pension receipt, telephone, and ATM functions, as well as EB, web transfer reception, bank deposit, and various seminars and consultations. Further, it provides business support services, such as digitization, merger and acquisition, financial diagnostics, industry-academia collaboration, employee benefits, and sales channel expansion and business matching; international business trade transactions; securities investment; and leasing operations. The Bank Of Kochi, Ltd. was incorporated in 1930 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Bank Of Kochi, Ltd.는 일본에서 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 은행사업, 리스사업, 신용카드사업 등 3개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 회사는 예금 및 종합 계좌를 제공합니다. 상속전용 및 퇴직급여전용 정기예금 및 외화예금 면세 소규모 투자 시스템; 축적투자 및 투자신탁; 연금 정기 지급; 기간자산관리; 정부 및 민간 배치 채권. 또한 자동차, 주택, 카드, 역모기지, 교육, 기업 대출 등의 대출 상품과 대출상담도 제공하고 있습니다. 의료보험, 암보험, 개인연금, 재산보험, 종신보험, 정기보험 등을 포함하는 보험상품; 후견 제도 지원 보증금; 신탁계약대리업; 개인형 확정기여형 연금제도; 유언 신탁 및 재산 정산 서비스; 교육 기부 전용 ​​계좌; 및 상속 절차. 또한, 인터넷뱅킹, 결제 및 이체, 전자화폐 및 스마트폰 결제, 급여이체, 외환 및 송금, 연금수령, 전화 등의 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
